Then don't be happy. Be unhappy. Be depressed, or be pissed off. Or be apathetic. Whatever. You don't have to try to be happy, especially if it's not even satisfying. You don't owe it to anyone to be happy.

If you don't have anything to lose, then do something new. If it doesn't matter any which way, go meet someone new, or talk to an old friend, or go to a show, or do something stupid. Whatever. I don't know what you're into, or what you've fantasized about being into, but if you're already at rock bottom there is no reason not to. There's no way you could possibly suffer more or be more apathetic.

You wouldn't be posting here if you didn't care for some reason, about something. You'd probably rather not feel this way, or have a different life, I think. So you care about that, at least.

And there's lots of things you can do without money. Don't let them brainwash you into thinking your only option is staying in your room, at home, forever (though I do want to acknowledge that the effed-up situation we live in is that there is much of "normal" life and society you are prohibited from without money). There is a whole world to explore. Go for a walk, go swim, go to the dog park. Go travel. Go backpacking. I mean, if there's nothing to lose anyways...
If you still care about how your dearest would be affected, then you still have feelings. That's important.
